x: A hearty welcome is extended to the undermentioned new members and we trust that they will have a long and happy association with us. D.

Don Adie was the other Belgravian in this race, and whilst he did not reach the final, showed promise. The next event, the 100 yards, was expected to be won by Grieve, but our two representatives were expected to show up well.
Don Adie (Discus and Long Jump), Alan Fleming (Javelin), Drew (Shot), Allen (Shot and Javelin), Freestone (Discus) and George (Long Jump), are names which come to mind.
Allan Dunn is with Combined Operations at Troon, and hopes to have a few runs on the beach to keep fit. Don. Adie is with the Royal Engineers at Aldershot.
